text: A Rite Pedestal holds and shows one item. Four of them around a Ritual Brazier make the **Rite Circle**, which every tablet rite needs, Spring Calling included.
A brazier's standing blessing does not need it: that only wants the seated seal and its totem.

pages.title: Draw the circle
pages.text: Brazier in the middle, four Rite Pedestals on the diagonals, chalk joining them.

pages.title: Using the circle
text: If the circle is incomplete, a tablet rite says the circle is not drawn and the tablet is not spent. Crouch and right-click the brazier with this book to see ghosts of what is missing.

Tablets can wait on the pedestals. A struck redstone signal on the brazier fires the seated rite with a pedestal's tablet that matches the seal, and a comparator reads whether a pedestal is occupied. That is how you put a [rite on a clock](redstone_language).

pages.title: Voices on the cardinals
pages.text: Seat four totems of the rite's own voice on the cardinals: the rite costs a quarter less and lasts twice as long.

pages.title: The stronger circle
text: The four cardinal totems only count when they match the rite being cast, so a Water circle helps Rain Calling and Spring Calling but not Dawn Calling.
It is optional. A plain circle casts every rite at full price.

pages.title: A seal rite by hand
text: A pedestal also takes a quick rite with no circle at all. Use an elemental **seal** on a Rite Pedestal: the seal is spent, and its voice works on you and everything within **6 blocks** for half a minute to two minutes.
If a cell you carry holds **8 Pulse**, the rite takes it and is **amplified**: stronger and longer.

Everyone within 6 blocks also gets the seal's [voice blessing](voice_blessings) for **5 minutes**, or 7 and a half at level II when amplified. Done in a tribe's camp, it counts as the rite their requests ask for.
A redstone signal on the pedestal refuses it.

pages.title: What each seal does
text: - **Earth**: resistance, absorption and haste; nearby hostiles are rooted, and the grass under the pedestal firms into path.
- **Fire**: fire resistance; hostiles catch fire, snow and ice melt, and cold campfires light.
- **Water**: water breathing and a swimmer's grace; fires go out and farmland is soaked. Amplified, it also hurries plants.
- **Air**: slow falling, speed and a higher jump; hostiles are blown back, and rain clears.
- **Spirit**: regeneration and night sight, lifts poison, wither, blindness, slowness, weakness and hunger, and heals every player near; hostiles glow and weaken.
- **Loom**: luck and speed; hostiles are drawn in and slowed, and every player near gets **12 Pulse** (24 amplified) threaded into their cells.
